study type: Prospective cohort study with historical controls
cohort: The study included 24 infants born to mothers who tested positive for COVID-19 during pregnancy, compared to 24 matched, healthy reference infants from a historical pre-COVID-19 data repository.
finding: There was no significant difference in passive respiratory system compliance (Crs) between infants born to COVID-19 positive mothers and the historical reference cohort, although the COVID-19 infants reported more allergic symptoms and conditions through 1-year.
